rules: An ID, once assigned, is PERMANENT — never renumber, never reuse, never re-map to a different strategy.
New strategy in an existing family -> next free member number (family.NM). Use strategy_registry.next_member(family).
Brand-new family -> next free family number (NN) + member .01. Use strategy_registry.next_family().
Rejected / failed / retired strategies KEEP their ID (status marks it); do NOT delete the row or reuse the number.

Internal keys (config_key / correlationId / order_store / files) are NOT the ID. The ID is a display + organization layer; the registry maps ID <-> every alias. Rename internals only via a deliberate, separately-approved migration.
status: paper | live | research | rejected | failed | legacy

field_guide._intro: Naming convention locked 2026-07-16. The rule that matters: an ID identifies the IDEA. Mode, transport, version and symbol are PROPERTIES — they never live in the name.
field_guide.name: '<Family> - <Role>'. Sentence case. BANNED tokens: _PAPER / _LIVE (mode is runtime and it lies — rsi_v1's config says mode:live), _V1 (version belongs to the script library), MAIN / default (say nothing).
field_guide.config_key: The EXACT key in nifty_config.json (or webhooks.<key>). This is what order_store.strategy + _risk.per_strategy are keyed on. NEVER rename it — that breaks P&L history and every RMS override.
field_guide.aliases: Older/other names this strategy is known by. resolve() matches these.
field_guide.role: reference | mirror | canary | standalone — what this deployment is FOR.
field_guide.transport: pine | python — who produces the signal. NOT part of the name.
field_guide.mirrors: ID this deployment is supposed to reproduce. A mirror's symbols + timeframe must match its reference; if they drift, the mirror is lying.
field_guide.never_live: true = must never place real orders, whatever `mode` says. Intent that a name cannot enforce (see 2026-07-16 finding: /api/start takes mode straight off a query param — no guard exists yet).
field_guide.desc: Why this is alive. Required for anything a future reader might mistake for a duplicate and switch off.

hidden._why: Identifiers that must NOT appear in any strategy list, picker, RMS table or log sidebar. NOT a delete and NOT a P&L exclusion — every order_store row stays exactly where it is and still counts in the money. This only stops dead/garbage names being rendered AS strategies. Single source: every surface reads this list, so a new one can't drift.

identifiers: Blank strategy field — 65 orders (15 LIVE) with no owner. order_store.strategy has no validation; something writes empty. Source not yet found.
identifiers.unknown: 13 orders, all LIVE. Same root as the blank one.
identifiers.ema920: Its TradingView pine's strategy id — 42 real fills on 2026-06-25, never registered. History stays, but it is not a strategy to show.
identifiers.52_Week_Breakout | Price closing above 5: A DESCRIPTION written into the strategy field. 1 order.
identifiers.global: The webhooks map's shared config block — not a strategy at all. Was rendering as a fake row in the RMS table.
identifiers.default: Webhook fallback config, superseded by named webhooks (arschain_MAIN). Its 22 orders (12 LIVE) are REAL history from before the named webhooks existed — they still count.
identifiers.vrp_v1: Dead config: present in config + RMS, zero orders, never registered. vrp_condor_v1 (02.03) is the live one.
identifiers.webhook_v1: The ORIGINAL single-webhook config (07.01), superseded by the per-strategy webhooks map. Zero orders. Kept because _all_webhooks() still falls back to it when the map is absent — so it stays FUNCTIONAL, just not shown. Hiding it removes the confusing second 'TradingView Webhook' row next to 04.04 DirectWebhook.
identifiers.ema_v1: Retired 2026-07-17 — zero orders ever placed, 4 MB/day of log noise, and it was the SILENT DEFAULT of /api/start (s='ema_v1'), /api/stop and /api/log (s='ema'), so any call with a wrong param name started or killed it by accident. Config key deleted; hidden here so no surface lists it.

_kept_visible.manual: Arsalan's own manual Zerodha trades, tagged deliberately by broker_sync.reconcile_manual_trades(). Real and wanted.

bucket_labels._why: Non-strategy order_store.strategy values that legitimately carry P&L (so a P&L table CANNOT hide them) but are NOT strategies. label()/regLabel() render these CLEAN names instead of the raw id, so 'unknown'/'default'/'manual'/'' never leak as raw text. Single source: Python bucket_labels() + JS registry.js both read it.

Re-homed from 01.01 (Chain-Zone research family); the credit/naked/positional structure-variants stay there for comparison. PAPER - forward-validate before real money (Rule 10).
